XYL.note: Purest large-cap water-tech play; pumps, transport, Sensus smart-metering, analytics. Deepest reimbursed pool of adaptation dollars

AWK.note: Largest US regulated water/wastewater utility; rate-base compounder, capex recovered through regulated returns. Scarcity gets priced into the rate base

WTRG.note: Aqua America water + Peoples gas; regulated water rate-base grower with a gas overhang that dilutes purity

PNR.note: Residential + commercial water treatment, filtration, pool. Consumer-cyclical tilt but real water-scarcity exposure

ECL.note: Industrial water treatment + hygiene compounder; water-scarcity pricing power with industrial customers, premium multiple

VLTO.note: Danaher water-quality spin (Hach, Trojan, ChemTreat); recurring-razor water-testing instruments + consumables. High-specificity

AOS.note: Water heating + residential water treatment; building-water exposure but consumer-housing cyclical

AWI.note: Ceilings + architectural specialties; resilient-building interiors, moisture/humidity performance. Non-res construction cyclical

CSL.note: Commercial roofing + waterproofing membranes; the building-envelope layer that keeps storms and water out. Re-roof demand is non-discretionary

IBP.note: Insulation + building-envelope installer; heat/cold resilience of the envelope. Tightly tied to housing starts

DE.note: Precision-ag machinery + guidance; water-efficient farming under drought. Ag-cycle cyclical but dominant franchise

CTVA.note: Drought-tolerant seed genetics + crop protection; the biology of ag adaptation. Seed-trait moat is hard to substitute

LNN.note: Zimmatic center-pivot irrigation pure-play; the literal water-delivery hardware for drought-stressed farms

VMI.note: Valley irrigation + infrastructure (poles/structures); irrigation pure-play blended with utility-structure exposure

NTR.note: Fertilizer + ag retail; input-intensity of resilient yields but commodity-fertilizer cyclicality dilutes the adaptation angle

VRSK.note: Catastrophe modeling + insurance analytics; the layer that literally prices flood/wind/wildfire risk. Recurring-subscription, high-margin, hard to replicate
